sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P./opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

By means of this application, the applicant, who is complainant in this case, has prayed for expeditious disposal of case being complaint case no. 52 of 2016 (Nanhaka vs. Girish and 3 others),
under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Vindhyachal, District Mirzapur presently pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Mirzapur within a time bound frame.

sentences.text: At the outset, learned A.G.A. pointed out that in this case, initially the accused persons were summoned vide order dated 31.08.2017 and the said order was challenged by the accused persons by means of Criminal Revision no. 163 of 2017, which was allowed vide order dated 22.10.2021 setting aside the summoning order dated 31.08.2017 and matter was remanded to the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate to pass fresh order.

Thereafter the accused persons have moved transfer application bearing no. 3ka, which was allowed vide order dated 05.05.2023 transferring the case from the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mirzapur to the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Mirzapur, but till date, no summoning order has been passed against the accused persons, therefore, the relief as sought for by the applicant by means of this application,
can not be granted at this stage.

On putting query, learned counsel for the applicant does not dispute the aforesaid factual submission of learned A.G.A.
Having heard the submission of learned counsel for the parties, I find force in the submission of learned A.G.A. that till date, the accused persons have not been summoned after remand order dated 22.10.2021 passed by Additional Sessions Judge in Criminal Revision No. 163 of 2017

,
therefore, the relief as sought by the applicant is refused at this stage.
The instant application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. is premature and is accordingly, dismissed.
It is made clear that this order will not come in the way of moving subsequent application by the applicant at the appropriate stage.
